units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:24">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>יֵין נ׳</he> wine from which a libation has been poured on the altar.—Pl. <he>נְסָכִים</he>, <he>נְסָכִין</he>; constr. <he>נִסְכֶי</he>, <cite ref="M01772"><he>נִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 9:1">Zeb. IX, 1</cite> <he>הנ׳ ירדו</he> the libations brought on the altar illegally, may be taken down.
<cite ref="Tosefta Zevahim 5:1">Tosef. ib. V, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 15b:12">Men. 15ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>נסכי בהמה</he> the libations connected with an animal sacrifice.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 2:4">Ib. II, 4</cite> <he>ונְסָכָיו</he> and the libations belonging thereto; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: יֵין נ׳ (יין שנתנסך לע״ז; abbrev. י״נ) wine known (or suspected) to have been manipulated by an idolater, wine forbidden to Jews because of such (known or suspected) manipulation.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:8">Ab. Zar. IV, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 55a:11">55ᵃ</cite>) <he>ואינו נעשה י״נ וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. <he>עושה</he>) it does not become (the gentile does not make it) forbidden wine until &c. Ib. V, 1 <he>לעשות עמו ביין נ׳</he> to work with him in wine dedicated to an idol. Ib. 2 <he>יין נ׳ שנפל וכ׳</he> if forbidden wine was poured over grapes. Ib. 74ᵃ bot. <he>יין נ׳</he> really idolatrous wine, opp. <he>סתם יין</he> suspected; a. fr.
